title: Finch official product description: goals and a virtual companion
claim: Finch describes linking daily goals and self-care activities to a virtual bird, with reflections, breathing and focus activities. These are publisher-described capabilities, not tested clinical outcomes.
limitations: Publisher description, not independent usability or efficacy testing.
No download, revenue, conversion or retention estimates were used.

title: Finch help center: core features and optional Plus benefits
claim: Finch says core self-care features remain free, while Plus adds customization and expanded options. This supports separating basic progress from optional paid features.
limitations: Publisher statement observed at retrieval; no current subscription price or purchase flow was tested.

title: Finch help center: adding and managing goals
claim: The help article documents adding personal goals, optional self-care areas, and saving goals to the home screen or settings. It supplies an inspectable task-flow reference.
limitations: Documentation was read; native interaction and accessibility were not tested.

title: Chillio official US App Store listing: planning and rewards
claim: The developer listing describes recurring habits, progress tracking and XP/coin rewards. Store descriptions are marketing statements; review complaints may describe older versions.
limitations: Identified by Apple app ID6748603301, not the unrelated Chillio Cleaning/TV apps.
No current feature, price or subscription transaction was independently tested.

title: ScreensDesign public Finch onboarding references
claim: The public article presents Finch welcome, egg selection, pet naming and check-in examples, and discusses clear action hierarchy and return paths. Its design commentary does not establish conversion effects.
limitations: Public article only; no authenticated ScreensDesign MCP session or gated screen archive was accessed.
No revenue estimates or retention claims from the site were adopted.
Patterns inspire original work; competitor screenshots are not reused in generated ads.
